environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS within a private subnet (10.0.64.0/19). The service is fronted by a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/internal-mesh-proxy. The subnet's route table has no IGW/NAT route for inbound traffic. Security group sg-0abc123def456 on the ENI allows ingress only from 10.0.0.0/16 on port 8443. DNS resolution for the service returns the private VPC endpoint IP (10.0.65.x) only within the VPC. There is no public hosted zone record. The EKS pod runs with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from pods with label app=mesh-sidecar in namespace istio-system.
